cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.
